objective: Add truthful decision-flow export and synchronized use-case comparison without weakening the authoritative runtime boundary or the existing product surfaces.

iterations.finding: The deployed authoritative graph, four top-level destinations, and 61-test baseline were stable.
iterations.change: Selected additive presentation features instead of restructuring the existing dashboard.

iterations.finding: A second use case has no runtime evidence and must not inherit the active cycle's status.
iterations.change: Defined the right lane as a synchronized contract preview and labeled it 'not executed'.
evidence: Playwright assertion requires the explicit preview label
Only the authoritative lane receives traceByStage

iterations.finding: No export module or split comparison existed.
iterations.change: Added failing unit, contract, and browser behaviors before implementation.
evidence: Unit test failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for flow-export
Contract test failed because buildDecisionFlowSvg was absent

iterations.finding: DOM screenshot libraries add dependency and CSS-cloning risk on a static site.
iterations.change: Built a deterministic standalone SVG from the same stage layout, statuses, branch, tasks, and active cursor used by the UI.
evidence: Export contains all nine data-stage markers

iterations.finding: VP handoff needs a raster option that works without an API route.
iterations.change: Added a client-only SVG-to-canvas-toBlob PNG path with object-URL cleanup and error reporting.
evidence: Rendered 2000x1240 PNG inspected from generated SVG
No server or API dependency introduced

iterations.finding: Dashed paths showed visited edges but the exact transition cursor was less obvious.
iterations.change: Added a moving SVG token only on the edge entering the current authoritative playback stage.
evidence: Token predicate uses activeStage and visited source

iterations.finding: The prior comparison cards exposed counts but not the complete branch topology.
iterations.change: Added two nine-stage lanes, branch visibility, task chips, and a synchronized cursor.

iterations.finding: New controls need stable names and the detailed view must not force document-level overflow.
iterations.change: Added named export/compare buttons, aria-pressed, aria-live export status, and responsive stacked lanes.
evidence: New controls use explicit accessible names

iterations.finding: Use-case and detail strings are embedded in downloadable XML.
iterations.change: Escaped XML entities and bounded exported detail/task lengths.
evidence: Export contains escaped markup instead of executable tags

iterations.finding: No new source, type, lint, unit, contract, model, or optimized-build issue remained; local browser acquisition was infrastructure-blocked.
iterations.change: Prepared focused Playwright download/comparison coverage for the installed-browser CI matrix and documented the local limitation.

truth_boundaries: The comparison lane is a configured contract preview, not a second executed cycle.
Exports contain operational evidence, policy, gates, tasks, and outcomes, not private chain-of-thought.
Static GitHub Pages does not gain external action authority from this presentation feature.
